items.reason: A: "Attack with a unit, even if it's exhausted" on a Force unit fires B's "When a friendly Force unit attacks: ...create your Force token". Agrees with haiku.
A: "Ready a unit and give a Shield token" readies Khetanna after attacking so "On Attack: The next Underworld unit you play... costs 1 resource less" fires again. Agrees with haiku.

A only makes units "enter play ready" (needs a Tatooine base); it does not ready an already exhausted unit or re-use an ability, and Ezra's trigger is "When a friendly unit's attack ends". Agrees with haiku.
B needs "an opponent controls an upgrade"; A is a Piloting upgrade only on a friendly Vehicle, so you control it. Agrees with haiku.
A deals damage to "this unit" (Haulcraft itself) and an enemy space unit; B's Grit needs damage on itself. Agrees with haiku.
A: "Attach to a friendly non-Vehicle unit" fits Axe Woves (Trooper); B gets "+1/+1 for each upgrade on him". Agrees with haiku.
A: "You may return a non-leader unit to its owner's hand" can return friendly Teeka, replaying "When Played: Choose one". Agrees with haiku.
A: "When Played: You may ready another unit" readies exhausted Executor, whose "When Played/On Attack/When Defeated: Create 3 TIE Fighter tokens" fires again on a second attack. Agrees with haiku.
A: "Attack with a unit, even if it's exhausted" (not bases) on Halo; its "When Attack Ends: If the defending unit was defeated, give a Shield token" can fire. Agrees with haiku.
A: "Attack with a unit" on Captain Rex fires "When this unit completes an attack: Give this unit and an enemy unit Sentinel". Agrees with haiku.
R2-D2 "can be played on a friendly Vehicle unit with a Pilot on it"; Axe Woves is a Trooper, not a Vehicle. Agrees with haiku.
B: "Attach to a Force unit"; A has printed trait Force. Agrees with haiku.
A: "If attached unit is Darth Maul, you may attack with him"; the attack is only by Maul, so C-3PO's "On Attack" does not fire. Agrees with haiku.
A: "When you play a unit... You may attack with a unit" can attack with Qui-Gon, firing "When Played/On Attack: Look at the top 3 cards". Agrees with haiku.
A: "Then, attack with the chosen unit" on Gorn fires "On Attack: Take control of an enemy Credit token". Agrees with haiku.
A is "Attach to a Vehicle unit" so it cannot upgrade a base; B needs "an upgraded base". Agrees with haiku.
A: "You may deal damage to a unit equal to the number of friendly Credit tokens" (at least 1) can damage a friendly unit, enabling B's "If you control a damaged unit". Agrees with haiku.
A: "You may attack with another Aggression unit"; Poggle is Aggression and deployed has "On Attack: You may ready a friendly Creature unit". Agrees with haiku.
A: "attack with a unit" fires Shin Hati's "When a friendly unit's attack ends" again (needs base damage for the payoff, trigger still occurs). Agrees with haiku.

A says "An opponent chooses one" of the modes and only one mode is the 5 damage, so A cannot reliably put damage on your own unit for B's "+1/+0 ... for each damage on it". Overrides haiku: correct -> wrong.
B: "give a Shield token to a damaged Vehicle unit"; A has printed trait Vehicle (must be damaged). Agrees with haiku.
A: "Ready a unit that was damaged this phase" can ready Migs after he attacks and takes damage, so "On Attack" fires again. Agrees with haiku.
A: "Defeat a non-leader unit" on friendly Magnaguard (printed power 5) fires "When Defeated: If this unit had 5 or more power... play this unit from your discard pile for free". Agrees with haiku.
A: "You may deal 1 damage to a ground unit" can hit friendly Qui-Gon (Ground, 5 HP), whose "Grit" gains power per damage. Agrees with haiku.
A: "Attack with a friendly unit. Then attack with it again"; Paige as Pilot gives "On Attack: Give an Experience token to this unit...", firing twice. Agrees with haiku.
